title: Exploring the heart-brain axis: Network pharmacological analysis of 10 Saudi Arabian spices in Alzheimer's and cardiovascular diseases.
authors: Javed, Amna; Youn, Kumju; Ho, Chi-Tang; Jun, Mira
one_liner_zh: 该文研究沙特香料成分对阿尔茨海默病和心血管疾病的网络药理学分析，涉及蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is the leading cause of morbidity and mortality in ageing adults worldwide. As CVD substantially increases the risk of Alzheimer's disease (AD) through shared pathophysiological mechanisms involving the heart-brain axis, bidirectional regulation of this axis holds promise for disease prevention. Saudi Arabian spices have long been used not only as culinary ingredients, but also as traditional medicines due to their diverse activities with fewer side effects. The present study aimed to identify preventive bioactive candidates from ten Saudi Arabian spices using network pharmacology and molecular simulations to uncover key hub genes and shared disease pathways in AD and CVD. A total of 51 compounds were selected based on optimized ADMET properties, and 661 overlapping genes were identified as potential targets. Protein-protein interaction analysis prioritized AKT1, SRC, and TP53 as hub genes and transcription factor/miRNA network analyses further supported their regulatory relevance. Kaempferol, apigenin and myristic acid were identified as regulators of these hub genes, targeting insulin signaling, microglial activation, RAGE-mediated vascular dysfunction, vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation, and apoptosis. Docking and molecular dynamics simulations revealed stable and specific binding interactions between these compounds and hub gene encoded proteins. These findings suggest that our active compounds have strong interactions with key hub genes in the heart-brain axis, providing novel insights into potential biomarkers and preventive candidates for AD and CVD.
abstract_zh: 心血管疾病（CVD）是全球老年人发病和死亡的主要原因。由于CVD通过涉及心脑轴的共同病理生理机制显著增加阿尔茨海默病（AD）的风险，因此对该轴的双向调控有望用于疾病预防。沙特阿拉伯香料长期以来不仅用作烹饪原料，还因其多样化的活性和较少的副作用而被用作传统药物。本研究旨在利用网络药理学和分子模拟技术，从十种沙特阿拉伯香料中识别预防性生物活性候选物，以揭示AD和CVD中的关键枢纽基因及共享疾病通路。基于优化的ADMET特性共筛选出51种化合物，并鉴定出661个重叠基因作为潜在靶点。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析将AKT1、SRC和TP53列为枢纽基因，转录因子/miRNA网络分析进一步支持了它们的调控相关性。山奈酚、芹菜素和肉豆蔻酸被确定为这些枢纽基因的调控因子，靶向胰岛素信号传导、小胶质细胞激活、RAGE介导的血管功能障碍、血管平滑肌细胞增殖和凋亡。对接和分子动力学模拟揭示了这些化合物与枢纽基因编码蛋白之间稳定且特异的结合相互作用。这些发现表明，我们的活性化合物与心脑轴中的关键枢纽基因具有强相互作用，为AD和CVD的潜在生物标志物及预防候选物提供了新见解。
